info.description:
### Fake data Generator Library
---
### Description
- This library intends to generate Fake Information based on the keys provided and count associated with them
- You can generate "n" number of information using this library
- This library internally uses `Faker` and `Phone-gen` library
---
### Usage 
1 : Install the requirements library
: [Faker](https://pypi.org/project/Faker/) and [phone-gen](https://pypi.org/project/phone-gen/)

2 : Import the library
```
from fake_data_generate import generate_data_info
```

3 : Call the function module
```
generate_data_info(name_count=3, zip_count=3, address_count=3, region='IN')
```

4 : Response [ This response might change due to random generation ]
```
{   'Address': [   '4711 Michael Canyon Suite 195\nGordonport, NV 01575',
                   '73989 Candace Course\nSouth Brian, ME 01819',
                   'Unit 7929 Box 8142\nDPO AA 71863'],
    'Name': ['Taylor Lopez', 'Margaret Patrick', 'Jessica Henry'],
    'Occupation': ['Engineering geologist'],
    'PhoneNumber': ['7989441126'],
    'SSN_or_EIN': ['927641785'],
    'State': ['Iowa'],
    'Transaction_Value': ['2924'],
    'ZIP_or_POSTAL': ['21834', '55542', '37100']
}
```
---
### Default Values
- By default, all the count params are set to count = 1 
- Region = "US"
- Trans_range = [1,6]
- Signed_Num = "False"
----

### Optional Arguments 
- -h, --help :: show this help message and exit
- --name_count NAME :: Number of names to generate
- --address_count ADDRESS :: Number of addresses to generate
- --phone_count PHONE :: Number of phone numbers to generate
- --zip_count ZIP :: Number of zip codes to generate
- --state_count STATE :: Number of states to generate
- --region_count REGION :: Region based on which phone-num is generated
- --occupation_count OCCUPATION :: Number of occupations to generate
- --trans_count TRANS_COUNT :: Number of Transaction Values to generate
- --trans_range TRANS_RANGE [TRANS_RANGE ...] :: The character length range upto which transaction values can be generated. Use [start, end] structure
- --signed_num SIGNED_NUM :: If set to "true", the number can be both positive and negative randomly. Default=False, only positive number
- --ssn_or_ein_count SSN_OR_EIN :: Number of occupations to generate Social Security Number or Employment Identification Number
---
